controls.label: Shape
controls.notes: Neutral gray over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Corrected JPL v2 SPC model; the original v1 solution is excluded. Neutral gray (#808080 sRGB) is a shared display convention, not measured surface color or albedo.

controls.label: Ice absorption
controls.notes: Water-ice absorption relative to a native 1.82–2.20 µm continuum. Six calibrated Cassini VIMS observations cover selected regions; gray grid marks unsupported areas. Strength also varies with viewing geometry and grain size. Archive noise filtering is retained; no photometric correction is applied. This is not ice percentage.

controls.label: Infrared ratio
controls.notes: Median reflectance in three channels near 3.1 µm divided by the near-1.66 µm channel. This samples an ice-sensitive infrared feature in six calibrated Cassini observations. Illumination, grain size and noise affect the ratio; it is not a crystallinity percentage or a temperature map. Archive filtering remains; no photometric correction. Gray grid marks unsupported areas.
